proposals.sourceQuote: On-Demand Instance hibernation is not available.
proposals.rationale: AWS documents multiple EC2 differences in AWS GovCloud, including purchasing, AMI/snapshot migration, instance screenshot, hibernation, and networking behavior. Core EC2 remains available, so the proposed lag is Moderate rather than Significant.

proposals.sourceQuote: AWS Lambda Function URLs is not available.
proposals.rationale: AWS documents several Lambda features unavailable in AWS GovCloud, including Function URLs, selected event-source features, JSON log formatting, KMS encryption for zip packages, SnapStart variants, and monitoring integrations. Core Lambda remains available, so the proposed lag is Moderate.

proposals.sourceQuote: Amazon S3 Express One Zone is not available.
proposals.rationale: AWS documents multiple S3 differences in AWS GovCloud, including no direct bucket copy to or from another AWS Region, no MFA Delete, no Transfer Acceleration, no S3 Express One Zone, no S3 Tables replication, and no S3 Metadata. Core S3 remains available, so the proposed lag is Moderate.

proposals.sourceQuote: Amazon EKS on Fargate isn’t available.
proposals.rationale: AWS documents EKS differences in AWS GovCloud, including no EKS on Fargate, Managed Service for Prometheus, S3 CSI driver add-on support, EKS Anywhere, or EKS Hybrid Nodes. Core EKS remains available, so the proposed lag is Moderate.

proposals.sourceQuote: Multi-AZ DB clusters are not available.
proposals.rationale: AWS documents RDS differences in AWS GovCloud, including unavailable Multi-AZ DB clusters, RDS Custom for SQL Server, cross-Region read replicas, DB snapshot copying, proactive recommendations, and zero-ETL integration. The mapped row includes RDS and the core managed database service remains available, so the proposed lag is Moderate.
